organization.name: Umami Software, Inc.
organization.notes: Privacy policy names Umami Software, Inc.; investor-issued July 2022 announcement confirms $1.5 M pre-seed led by Race Capital and founders Mike/Brian/Francis Cao. Exact legal company formation year not established; not conflated with earlier project origin. Historical investor not asserted to own a current fixed percentage.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted Umami
pricingTiers.notes: Open source distribution; infrastructure costs separate. Hosted Hobby separately free with 100 K events/month.
No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Cloud Business includes 10 M events/month; additional events $0.00002 each and replay overage separate. No published annual total found.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Cloud Enterprise Custom pricing/Contact us; SAML and custom retention. No paid self-host license inferred.

moats.claim: Privacy-oriented instrumentation plus growing analysis/report breadth creates workflow differentiation, while permissively licensed code limits engine exclusivity.

productReasons.claim: Funnels, retention and journey analysis support investigating conversion drop-offs and repeat visits.
Custom events, event/session properties and goals add behavioral context beyond pageview totals.
UTM/ad-click attribution and Web Vitals metrics connect campaign traffic to measured page experience.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: pnpm used to build; Node runtime runs application.
Current v 3 docs list Postgre SQL; old My SQL routes not treated as current.
Without Redis, direct DB lookups and JWT authentication are supported.
Set DIRECT_DATABASE_URL for migrations when DATABASE_URL uses pooler.

resources.notes: No universal production hardware minimum verified; size to actual workload.

selfHosting.notes: Current installation documents Postgre SQL and source/container/Kubernetes alternatives. Optional Redis explicit; My SQL legacy excluded. Hosting provider integrations do not remove database requirements.

options.name: Vercel deployment button
options.notes: Official guide says button automates steps 1–5; Postgre SQL/connection configuration and changing default password still required.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official Running on Vercel guide explicitly offers automation button for deployment steps; recorded official deployment URL. Manual Compose is separate.
